title: 1910. Remove All Occurrences of a Substring

examples.explanation: The following operations are done: - s = "daabcbaabcbc", remove "abc" starting at index 2, so s = "dabaabcbc". - s = "dabaabcbc", remove "abc" starting at index 4, so s = "dababc". - s = "dababc", remove "abc" starting at index 3, so s = "dab". Now s has no occurrences of "abc".

The following operations are done: - s = "axxxxyyyyb", remove "xy" starting at index 4 so s = "axxxyyyb". - s = "axxxyyyb", remove "xy" starting at index 3 so s = "axxyyb". - s = "axxyyb", remove "xy" starting at index 2 so s = "axyb". - s = "axyb", remove "xy" starting at index 1 so s = "ab". Now s has no occurrences of "xy".
